data.why: These are the repo's own trimmed test fixtures (TA Trios DSC, Raman CSV, Bruker FTIR .dpt, Agilent JCAMP-DX NMR, TopSpin totxt 2D NMR) copied verbatim so a scientist can exercise every QUICK-tab step (scan/upload -> filter by technique -> overlay -> compare formats -> convert) entirely offline via the app's drag-and-drop upload, without needing the backend to reach GitHub/Drive/Box at runtime.

goals: Load a DSC heat-flow-vs-temperature curve and inspect the melting/glass-transition features across repeated heat-cool cycles
Overlay a Raman spectrum and an FTIR spectrum of the same compound (CBD) to compare vibrational bands across techniques
Load a 1D NMR spectrum from JCAMP-DX and a 2D CPMG dataset exported as TopSpin totxt, and inspect their signals
Convert a parsed dataset to a standard interchange format (CSDM, HDF5, CSV, Parquet, or Feather) for downstream analysis
Edit a dataset's sample/instrument/condition metadata in the DATA workspace panel before exporting
Export a notebook (Colab .ipynb or marimo .py) that reproduces the fetch-and-plot for a selected dataset

review.summary: The tree follows the tool's real stages (load and classify, filter, overlay and inspect, add metadata, convert or export a notebook), and most of the evidence I checked matches, including the honest note that the network worked and the full DSC, Raman and FTIR curves came from yargerlab/Data. Before filing it needs the README's 'compare formats' step and the QUICK single-source path, two re-cited screens, a corrected NMR overlay claim, and some merging of plot-control tasks.
